profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bombora
profile.summary:
With a solid foundation in computer science and a Master's in Business Administration, my journey as a Software Engineer has been marked by leveraging many technologies to enhance software solutions with extensive experience in .NET, microservices, and cloud services. At Bombora, our dedication to innovation has led to the architecture and development of robust software systems.

Fluent in Spanish, I bring a global perspective and a communicative edge to cross-functional collaboration. My academic achievements, such as a 3.9 GPA and recognition as Most Outstanding Student, are testaments to my commitment to excellence and continuous learning in the fast-evolving tech landscape.
